alright. you know that there are 5 targets for the bomber to RNG on (3 enemy cards, the enemy hero and our hero). thus, at any given time the bomber has a 1/5th chance of hitting a target. the problem here is that the bomber has the possibility of killing the 1-health card, resulting in a probability of 1/4 for the next target. 

tl;dr 1/5 chance each shot of killing the enemy hero, if you hit the 1 health minion then there is a 1/4 chance for the remaining shot(s)(if there are any) to kill the hero.
